column1: # Everyday words for characters whose names and keywords do not use them.
# Format: word<TAB>items, as in aliases.tsv: items are separated by single
# spaces, each a literal character or sequence, or U+XXXX notation for
# invisible or ambiguous characters, in order of preference. Words are
# matched case-insensitively and may be short phrases.
# A related word suggests its items without naming them. Searching for the
# whole word lists them in this order after everything the word names
# through a Unicode name, a CLDR keyword or an alias, and before any partial
# match. A related word does not change an item's rank. Put a name people
# use for a character in aliases.tsv instead.
# The generator rejects a word that is also an alias, an item the word
# already finds by name, keyword or alias, and skin-tone variants. Search
# reduces plurals, -ed and -ing forms and British spellings to their base
# form when nothing matches them as typed, so list the base form (approve,
# not approved) unless the inflected form means something else.
